d: Bihar ke madhubni jile ke babubarhi thana kshetr antargat balirajgarh ganv se ek sanasnikhej aur khaki ko sharmasar kar dene vali ghatna samne aaee hai. der rat ek mahila se milne pahunche babubarhi thane ke eesaaaee (ASI) chandramohan ko jab graminon ne ghera, to unhonne apni sarkari sarvis pistal se andhadhundh phayring kar di. is golibari men 50 varshiy ashok yadav ki mauke par hi maut ho gaee, jinki aane vale disanbar men shadi hone vali thi.
